name: OPCPCareStages
title: Operational Care Pathway (OPCP) Care Stages
description: Care stage codes for Operational Care Pathway (OPCP) used in military/pre-hospital trauma care. Defines progression from point of injury through strategic evacuation.
purpose: To provide standardized codes for care stages in the OPCP framework, enabling structured tracking of patient journey through military healthcare system.

concept.definition: Initial point of wounding or illness onset
Evacuation from point of injury to next care facility
Medical evacuation with care during transport
Role 1 Pre-Hospital Emergency Care - Initial stabilization
Role 1 Primary Healthcare - Outpatient medical services
Role 2 Deployed Hospital Care - Resuscitative surgery capability
Role 3 Deployed Hospital Care - Full hospital capability
Strategic evacuation to definitive care facility
